thread:
emily (sales): Quick ask 12Labs wants a 36hr POC. They need a dedicated pool: 5 reserved GPUs, burst to 12 for two 45-min demo windows each day, rotated API key scoped to the POC, and an IP allowlist or VPC peering. Need feasibility + rough cost ASAP.

rachel (solutions): Which model and expected sequence lengths? Any hard latency SLO for the public demo?

emily (sales): Model: redwood-34b-rtq, typical seq 1024, occasional 2048. Demo is public-facing, target median latency <300ms, peak ~100 concurrent users.

omar (eng-infra): Feasible. Proposed defaults: reserved=5, burst_max=12, burst_windows=45m twice/day, autoscale cooldown 3m, scheduled headroom to pre-allocate 2 warm slots. Need exact UTC windows and CIDR if peering. We'll create a dedicated RBAC group for the POC.

kai (eng-runtime): For 34b-rtq at 2048 enable KV prefix cache + continuous batching. Also recommend token-cap per session (e.g., 2048) and a burst-throttle that aborts new burst allocations if projected token spend > $600/hr. Add soft-degrade route to 13b-quant when queue > 60s. Pin model revision to avoid surprises.

jana (security): If they want peering we need completed security questionnaire and their SOC contact. Otherwise we can issue a rotated ephemeral API key with 72h TTL and IP allowlist. Keys will be least-privilege and scoped to project:labspoc. We also require signed AUP for peering.

leon (finance): Back-of-envelope: reserved 5 GPUs x 2 days ~= 240 GPU-hrs reserved; potential burst up to ~180 GPU-hrs. Very rough incremental cost $5k-$10k depending on utilization. I can provision a $3k buffer for overage. Need final burst-hours to give a firm quote.

emily (sales): Demo schedule: Apr 22 15:00-16:00 UTC and Apr 23 14:00-15:00 UTC. They prefer peering but will accept allowlist if that speeds things up. I'll ask for network contact.

omar (eng-infra): CLI we'll run: 

```
rictl pool create \
  --name 12labs-poc-apr \
  --reserved 5 \
  --burst-max 12 \
  --burst-windows "45m,45m" \
  --scheduled-headroom 2 \
  --token-cap 2048 \
  --burst-throttle "$600/hr" \
  --rbac "team:12labs-poc" \
  --notes "POC: rotated key + ip allowlist or peering pending; pin model; dry-run before demo"
```

infra-bot: created INFRA-POC-5782 assigned to omar (eng-infra)

omar (eng-infra): Will provision once we have: final windows (confirmed), CIDR if peering or IP list, security questionnaire status, and finance buffer approval. ETA: 36hrs after inputs.

leon (finance): Approving provisional $3k buffer. Escalate if projected spend > $8k.

rachel (solutions): I'll prepare a short runbook and dry-run checklist (include simulated load test, token-cost tracing, kill-switch steps, and model pin instructions). Emily 12Labs 56I'll ask for network CIDR and SOC contact today.

\emily (sales): Thanks all 10Please aim to have infra ready by 2026-04-20 for a dry-run. I'll update when I have CIDRs. :thumbsup:
